reasons: Lens B does not evaluate the substantive taxonomy of the home-role assignment.

defect.evidence_quote: Old as_of seeds as_of_treatment; S2 derivation re-derives and may downgrade.
defect.problem: The good_law label matches the lake judgment field, but the page's unqualified treatment phrasing is too strong because the same disclosed record flags unaudited proposed negative events and says the migrated seed may be downgraded.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep good_law as the disclosed final treatment field, but replace any unqualified 'No negative treatment' phrasing with 'No confirmed negative treatment in the final lake treatment field; proposed negative hits remain unaudited.'

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law and varies_by_point is false, with no point_overrides.
However, the lake derivation marks lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited audit_needed true and records proposed_negative_events.

All listed negative-looking treatment edges are proposed and field_iii is mentioned, so they do not prove overruling, but they make 'No negative treatment' unsafe without a confirmed-treatment qualifier.
residual_risks: A CourtListener/audit pass would be needed to convert proposed edges into confirmed negative treatment or clear them.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Expose the migration/audit caveat wherever the visible page says the case has no negative treatment.

reasons: Lake identity lists court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level/court_id as scotus.

residual_risks: Weight label is jurisdiction-general; no disclosed point-specific limitation changes the court-level weight.
